facts.text: Throughout the history of the Galactic Republic, Rhen Var was covered in ice, rendering it almost uninhabitable.

evidence.quote: Throughout the history of the Galactic Republic, Rhen Var was covered in ice, rendering it almost uninhabitable.

facts.text: Remains of an ancient civilization and old Jedi artifacts were found beneath the ice on the planet, remnants of a former civilization.

evidence.quote: Remains of an ancient civilization and old Jedi artifacts were found beneath the ice on the planet, remnants of a former civilization.

facts.text: Rhen Var was once a fertile paradise filled with vegetation and wildlife.

evidence.quote: Rhen Var was once a fertile paradise filled with vegetation and wildlife.

facts.text: Thousands of years before the Clone Wars, an atmospheric cataclysm turned it into an icy hibernal surface.

evidence.quote: Thousands of years before the Clone Wars, an atmospheric cataclysm turned it into an icy hibernal surface.

facts.text: Since then, it had been a frigid world of frozen tundra and snow swept mountains.

evidence.quote: Since then, it had been a frigid world of frozen tundra and snow swept mountains.

facts.text: During the time of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, the Rakata ruled Rhen Var.

evidence.quote: During the time of the Rakatan Infinite Empire, the Rakata ruled Rhen Var.

facts.text: In those millennia a civilization flourished, building castles, fortresses and temples; eventually it went extinct due to the advance of a planetary ice age that, by the Post-Manderon period, took over, and snow engulfed the ruins of their creations.

evidence.quote: In those millennia a civilization flourished, building castles, fortresses and temples; eventually it went extinct due to the advance of a planetary ice age that, by the Post-Manderon period, took over, and snow engulfed the ruins of their creations.

facts.text: Later, Jedi Knight Satele Shan and a large Republic army battled Darth Mekhis and a force of Sith during the last months of the Great Galactic War.

facts.text: Prior to the Clone Wars, the Republic set up a small supply base and listening post on Rhen Var.

facts.text: At the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems seized Rhen Var with an army so large that the Republic base had to evacuate the planet.

evidence.quote: At the start of the Clone Wars in 22 BBY, the Confederacy of Independent Systems seized Rhen Var with an army so large that the Republic base had to evacuate the planet.

facts.text: The Separatists' motives in taking the world were unclear until Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker discovered Count Dooku uncovering the Force Harvester on Raxus Prime.

facts.text: The answers to its power would be located in the tomb of Ulic Qel-Droma on Rhen Var.

facts.text: During the battle, Anakin learned from Qel-Droma's Force ghost how to defeat the Force Harvester which would power the Dark Reaper located on the ancient Sith world of Thule.
